items.exampleEn: On the small island, donkeys still carry goods up the steep streets.
items.exampleZh: 在那座小島上，驢子至今仍會把貨物載上陡峭的街道。

items.exampleEn: A crocodile can stay under the water for more than an hour.
items.exampleZh: 鱷魚可以在水下待一個多小時。

items.exampleEn: Penguins cannot fly, but they are excellent swimmers.
items.exampleZh: 企鵝不會飛，但牠們是游泳高手。

items.exampleEn: The country has a long coastline with hundreds of small beaches.
items.exampleZh: 這個國家有很長的海岸線，有數百個小海灘。

items.exampleEn: The baby birds opened their beaks wide, waiting for food.
items.exampleZh: 雛鳥張大嘴巴等著吃東西。

items.exampleEn: My little sister collects smooth pebbles in a glass jar.
items.exampleZh: 我妹妹把光滑的小鵝卵石收集在一個玻璃罐裡。

items.exampleEn: The ecologist warned that the new hotel would harm the frogs in the pond.
items.exampleZh: 那位生態學家警告，新飯店會危害池塘裡的青蛙。

items.exampleEn: The news said a landslide had closed the mountain road for two days.
items.exampleZh: 新聞說，一場山崩讓山路封閉了兩天。
items.glossZh: 山崩；土石流；（選舉）壓倒性勝利

items.sentenceEn: We walked along the coastline and watched the waves hit the rocks.
items.sentenceZh: 我們沿著海岸線散步，看著海浪拍打岩石。

items.audioEn: The penguin show starts at two, right after the fish feeding.
items.audioZh: 企鵝表演兩點開始，就在餵魚時間結束後。
items.questionZh: 企鵝表演在什麼之後開始？

items.sentenceEn: The farmer's old donkey refused to move until it got an apple.
items.sentenceZh: 農夫的老驢子不肯動，直到拿到一顆蘋果才走。

items.sentenceEn: Heavy rain can cause landslides on hills without trees.
items.sentenceZh: 大雨可能讓沒有樹木的山坡發生土石流。

items.stemEn: The beach has no sand, only small, round ____ in many colors.
items.stemZh: 那個海灘沒有沙，只有許多顏色的小圓石。

items.stemEn: The ____ on our team studies how plants, animals and their environment affect each other.
items.stemZh: 我們團隊的生態學家研究植物、動物與環境之間如何互相影響。

items.passageEn: My cousin is an ecologist who studies birds along the southern coastline. In her latest report, she explains how a bird's beak shape matches the food it eats. Some birds have long, thin beaks for catching fish, while others have short, strong ones for cracking seeds. Last winter, a small landslide covered part of the beach with rocks, so she had to move her camp. She now works near a quiet bay full of pebbles, where she sometimes sees farmers riding donkeys. She also leads school excursions there. She jokes that the only animals she has never seen there are crocodiles and penguins.
items.passageZh: 我的表親是生態學家，研究南部海岸線上的鳥類。在她最新的報告裡，她說明鳥嘴的形狀如何配合牠吃的食物。有些鳥的嘴又長又細，適合抓魚；有些則又短又強壯，適合敲開種子。去年冬天，一場小山崩讓一部分海灘覆滿了石頭，所以她必須把營地搬走。她現在在一個滿是鵝卵石的寧靜海灣工作，有時會看到農夫騎著驢子經過，她也會在那裡帶學校的戶外教學。她開玩笑說，那裡唯一沒見過的動物就是鱷魚和企鵝。

questions.questionZh: 作者表親的報告在講什麼？
options: 鳥嘴形狀如何配合食物

questions.questionZh: 作者的表親為什麼要搬營地？

items.promptZh: 鱷魚張開嘴巴躺在河邊曬太陽。
referenceEn: The crocodile lay by the river in the sun with its mouth open.
A crocodile was lying by the river in the sun with its mouth open.
rubricZh: 動物可用 it，也可用 he、she；時態合理即可

items.promptZh: 企鵝爸爸會幫忙照顧蛋。
referenceEn: Penguin fathers help take care of the eggs.
Male penguins help look after their eggs.
rubricZh: penguin 指企鵝，泛指用複數（例如 penguin fathers、male penguins 等）
一般事實用現在式；「照顧」可寫，例如 take care of、look after 等
